status: pre-commit — written after docs/23 signed, before any order code or arm
question: After matching the measured task's position, does consecutive-Hamming dose beyond the cliff further separate schedules?
why_now: Second-learner line closed (docs/07 §A.9). Order and spacing are single-learner stream axes. The original prediction (order should not matter) was too strong because order moves position. The audit's weaker prediction is the testable version.
weaker_prediction: After matching the measured task's position, consecutive-Hamming dose beyond the cliff should not further separate schedules.
framing: geometry with a well-specified stream. Not a substitute second learner.

design.manipulation: Same bag of 16 (arrangement, dichotomy) pairs as the Hamming 2×3 cell. Presentation order is forward (existing Hamming slice), reverse, or shuffle. Pairs stay glued. Matched composition.

schedules.forward: Generated order. Read from results/hamming/. Not rerun.
schedules.reverse: Presentation indices 15..0. Consecutive Hamming preserved on a constant-Hamming walk. Position manipulation.
schedules.shuffle: One permutation per stream_id from order_rng(stream_id), rejected if identity or reverse. Consecutive Hamming realized, not designed.

design.stopping: matched_loss at target_loss 0.05. Sequential K=1. Registered pin. Not re-pinned.

hamming_levels.why: Beyond the cliff. s_r=1 is finding-3 recovery on forward, already measured, not a dose cell here.

frozen.what: cliff, no post-cliff dose under SGD

drift.what: cliff plus resolved post-cliff dose under SGD

schedule_B.why: Position stays a covariate. Lag 4 exists for presentation indices {0,2,4,6,8,10}.

first_slice.jump_excluded: Jump has no post-cliff dose. Not this slice.
first_slice.gamma_1_excluded: Single-learner stream axis. Primary at γ=10.

held_fixed.lr0_provenance: Registered GD pin. Hamming one-arm reached. Not informed by this axis.

primary_cell.task: the dichotomy trained at presentation index 8
primary_cell.quantity: Δ log α (floors), schedule range across {forward, reverse, shuffle}
primary_cell.why_not_task0_lag12: Reverse puts original task 0 last. Position matching is the point of the weaker prediction.
primary_cell.reported_not_a_reading: Lag-4 series across presentation index. Δρ_c.

recovery.inherited: Hamming slice finding 3 at s_r=1, forward, drift vs jump. Do not rerun. Not a reading of this arm.

misses.rule: An arm that misses target_loss on any task is unusable and counted.
misses.if_one_arm_misses: Stop. Do not re-pin lr0. The GD pin already reached on Hamming.

one_arm_first.spec: γ=10, reverse, drift, s_r=0.75, first reserved arrangement, a=0, N=300, quadratic, matched_loss, target_loss=0.05, lr0=5, tracked_stride=2, SGD, MSE
one_arm_first.why: A cell this slice trains. Not a forward Hamming cell. AGENTS.md §5.

readings_committed_before_seeing_numbers.weaker_prediction_holds: On frozen and on drift, schedule range at s_r=0.25 minus schedule range at s_r=0.75 does not clear two floors (lag 4, presentation index 8, 1-decimal). Consecutive-Hamming dose beyond the cliff does not further separate schedules.
readings_committed_before_seeing_numbers.weaker_prediction_fails: That difference clears two floors on frozen and on drift. Name the magnitudes.
readings_committed_before_seeing_numbers.partial: One input holds, the other fails. Report the split. No post-hoc story.
readings_committed_before_seeing_numbers.forward_identity_fails: A forward cell used as the third schedule does not match the Hamming slice. Stop. The pairing is broken.

operationalization.primary: Unique n=8, module A, lag 4, presentation index 8, Δ log α, γ=10. 95% CI = mean ± 1.96 SEM.
operationalization.schedule_range: max − min of 1-decimal floors across {forward, reverse, shuffle} at that cell.
operationalization.weaker_prediction_holds: For frozen and for drift: range(0.25) − range(0.75) < 2 floors.
operationalization.weaker_prediction_fails: For frozen and for drift: range(0.25) − range(0.75) ≥ 2 floors.
operationalization.partial: Exactly one of frozen, drift satisfies holds.
operationalization.forward_identity_fails: Any paired forward record disagrees with results/hamming/ on spec or on the primary-cell Δ log α of the eight stream_ids.
operationalization.a8: A monotonicity claim on schedule range requires the difference to clear two floors, not just the ordering to hold.

will_not_do: Include s_r=1 as a dose cell.
Inform lr0 or stopping from this axis.
Salvage a stream claim from a partial split after seeing numbers.
